name: Audit Gate
description: Keeps the auditor honest about evidence: no PASS without independent verification in that run, verdict-first replies, and only links actually retrieved. Shares per-run evidence with the grounded plugin.

agents.description: Auditor agent ids this plugin applies to. Default ["auditor"].

searchTools.description: Tool names that count as searches. Default ["web_search"].

fetchTools.description: Tool names that count as fetches. Default ["web_fetch"].

execTools.description: Tool names that count as running checks. Default ["exec", "bash"].

wrapperTools.description: Wrapper tools for deferred calls. Default ["tool_call"].

checkPython.description: Python interpreter of the user's analysis environment, named in the audit checklist (e.g. ~/miniforge3/envs/scrna_workflow/bin/python).

stampUnverified.description: Rewrite an unverified 'AUDIT: PASS' in the auditor's saved reply so readers see it does not count. Default true.

auditSessionPattern.description: Regex for audit-only sessions. In these, an inter-session message that is not an audit request is treated as an agent-to-agent follow-up and answered with REPLY_SKIP. Default ^agent:[^:]+:(audits|eval-)

packFiles.description: Paths to pack.json files with domain knowledge (libraries, sources, examples, checklist items). Merged in order. Set by install.sh.

userName.description: How the agents refer to the person they work for (e.g. "Alex"). Default "the user".
